value.text: {"sql": "SELECT DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(hr_utc, '+00:00', '-05:00'), '%Y-%m-%d') AS day_cdt, HOUR(CONVERT_TZ(hr_utc, '+00:00', '-05:00')) AS peak_hour_cdt, MAX(usgs_northport_peak_cfs) AS max_peak_cfs FROM water.hourly_compare WHERE hr_utc BETWEEN '2026-10-18 06:00' AND '2026-10-25 06:00' GROUP BY day_cdt, peak_hour_cdt ORDER BY day_cdt, max_peak_cfs DESC LIMIT 200", "purpose": "Test if USGS Northport peak hour is consistently 21:00 CDT across Oct 18–22, confirming scheduled hydropower releases"}
